newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea o'seas investment approvals up in April.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea o'seas investment approvals up in April.

text.p: South Korea's direct overseas investment surged 44 percent to $528.1 million in April on an approval basis from $366.9 million a year ago, the Bank of Korea said on Thursday.
However, a central bank statement said the number of investments dropped to 108 in April from 140 a year earlier.

Actual overseas investments implemented by South Korean companies dropped sharply to $144 million in 80 cases in April from $259 million in 107 cases a year ago. Bank officials said domestic firms failed to carry out some of their investment plans because of difficulties in raising investment funds due to South Korea's economic slump and a series of corporate failures.
The bank said overseas investment approvals in manufacturing and telecommunication sectors saw strong gains in April.
By region, South Korea's investment approvals in Asia and South and Central America rose, while investment in North America slowed.
For the first four months of this year, direct overseas investment approvals fell to $1.82 billion in 477 cases against $1.95 billion in 653 cases in the same period a year ago.
